en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with red printed caption at the top showing a hillside landscape with vineyards and trees in the foreground. In the middle distance stands a large villa‑like building, and behind it on the slope is a tall multi‑storey structure with balconies, towers and a central spire, labeled as the Bilz Naturheilanstalt. Smaller houses dot the hills on both sides.
